linear_mrna.fto_governance_summary: All commercial_clean 5'UTRs, 3'UTRs, and homopolymeric A100/A120 tails pass SequenceFTOGuard v2.1.0 with zero blocked alerts; segmented A30L70 poly(A) is quarantined under BioNTech Family 51220548 (US10717982B2 / US12054723B2).

cmc_and_immunogenicity_rules: Do NOT apply 100% m1Psi co-transcriptional substitution to Group-I PIE + viral IRES constructs (abolishes ribozyme self-splicing and Type-I IRES folding).
Eliminate residual 5'-ppp linear precursors and nicked circles via Antarctic phosphatase + RNase R + SEC-HPLC to prevent RIG-I activation (Wesselhoeft et al. 2019 PMC6724735).
Check IRES-CDS antisense cross-hybridization and apply synonymous CDS uncoupling when base-pairing invades IRES functional stems (Huang et al. 2026 PMC13092624).

innate_sensing_and_replication_rules: Initiate transcript with authentic Cap-1 5'-AU (CleanCap AU) to preserve minus-strand synthesis and human IFIT1 evasion (Hyde et al. 2014 PMC3998667).
Lock 5'UTR, nsP1 51-nt CSE, 26S SGP, and 3' 19-nt CSE verbatim; forbid global codon optimization across nsP1 CSE.

Forbid 100% m1Psi/Psi substitution on cis-replicating alphavirus RNA; evaluate sub-microgram dose-sparing vs dsRNA replication-intermediate IFN-I reactogenicity on a explicit Pareto front (Vijayan et al. 2024 PMC11564874).
